watches.name: EPURATO MCF’s 30th Anniversary
watches.description: A 30th anniversary celebration! As an official partner of the Montreux Comedy Festival, ANONIMO has dedicated a 30-piece limited edition of its EPURATO watch featuring splashes of yellow – the festival's signature colour – to mark the occasion. The piece features the codes of the EPURATO collection, brought to life with touches of yellow – the festival's signature colour. The colour appears on the second hand and on the stitching of the Barenia black calf leather strap. The "Montreux Comedy" logo is engraved on the middle hoop at 9 o'clock, and the screw-on open case-back is decorated with a transfer depicting the festival's 30th anniversary logo. Case Diameter 42 mm, height 11.60 mm, satin steel 316L, cushion shape Galvanic opalin off-white dial Water-resistant to 50 meters, 5 ATM Fluted bezel Sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating Minute and hour hands with Super-LumiNova® Yellow varnished second hand Screw-in open case-back with the Montreux Comedy Festival's 30th anniversary transfer logo Montreux Comedy logo engraved on the middle hoop at 9 o'clock Movement Swiss Made SW 200-1, 11 ½''' self-winding, customised Anonimo oscillating weight Power reserve 38 hours minimum 26 jewels Frequency 28'800 A/h (4Hz) Date indication at 6 o’clock Strap Black Barenia calf leather with yellow stitching handmade in Italy - quick strap change device - steel pin buckle

watches.name: MILITARE Chrono Oxidized Bronze
watches.description: Reference: AM-1148.14.208.V09 - Web Exclusivity and Limited Edition of 25 pieces - It is said that, like wine, things get better with time and ANONIMO plays subtly with this saying. But life is short and we don't always want to wait forever. This is why we chose to accelerate things up a bit and produced unique chronograph as a web-exclusive limited edition of 25 highly desirable and collectible pieces. A careful oxidation process brings a warm and unique shade to the bronze case. This patina gives the piece a resolutely vintage style and a powerful and exclusive character while the hand-brushed blue dial gives it depth and charisma. This piece definitely does not go unnoticed... Case Diameter 43.50 mm, height 14.50 mm, oxidized bronze, cushion shape Blue dial with hand-brushed finish Water-resistant to 120 meters, 12 ATM Sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating Numbers, indexes and hands with Super-LumiNova® Crown with patented protection system at 12 o'clock Open case back Movement Swiss Made SW 300, 13 ¼'''' self-winding, personalized Anonimo oscillating weight with a bi-compax DD2035M chronograph module developed exclusively for Anonimo Power reserve 42 hours minimum 49 jewels Frequency 28'800 A/h (4Hz) 30-minute counter at 9 o'clock and central second, small second counter at 3 o'clock Strap Brown calf leather with with bronze colour stitching handmade in Italy Oxidized bronze pin buckle
